description: This file implements the GrainCallCancellationManager class, which manages cancellation of grain calls across a distributed Orleans cluster. It handles request batching, membership updates, and coordination with system targets to propagate cancellation requests to remote silos.

classes.name: IGrainCallCancellationManagerSystemTarget
classes.description: Interface for remote cancellation of grain calls, allowing cancellation requests to be sent to remote silos.

classes.name: GrainCallCancellationRequest
classes.description: Immutable struct representing a request to cancel a specific grain call, identified by target grain ID, source grain ID, and message ID.

classes.name: GrainCallCancellationManager
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing grain call cancellations within an Orleans silo, coordinating requests locally and across the cluster.

methods.name: CancelCallsAsync
methods.description: Processes a list of cancellation requests, attempting to cancel each call either directly or via remote grains.

methods.name: SignalCancellation
methods.description: Signals a cancellation request to a specific silo and grain, batching requests when possible.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Continuously monitors cluster membership changes to handle silo failures and cleanup related resources.

methods.name: PumpCancellationQueue
methods.description: Worker task that batches and sends cancellation requests to a remote silo.

methods.name: GetOrCreateWorker
methods.description: Creates and retrieves a worker channel and task for a target silo to handle cancellation requests.

methods.name: RemoveWorker
methods.description: Removes and cleans up a worker associated with a silo when it goes down or is no longer active.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Initialization logic for starting the cancellation manager; placeholder returning completed task.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Gracefully terminates all worker tasks and membership updates, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the manager to the silo lifecycle to start and stop its operations accordingly.
